notes.title: Exterminators of Saturn played by the developers Pre Recorded
notes.content:
This is a pre recording of the live stream previously played on Feb 6th 2pm est. We played through the game several times and discussed the dev process, decisions made, and future plans. Come try out the game and download the demo. Wishlist us if you enjoyed yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44202186/5b05499ff3cb69e6fd94b98d878c1d2d09afaba9.png[/img]

notes.title: Shootin' the Shi... Talking about the game and shooting alien bugs
notes.content: Watch the developers play Exterminators of Saturn and answer questions LIVE. We will run through the demo and discuss our plans for the game upon release, Work we've done since the demo was built and ideas we are working into the game.
